title: The Episode About the Khalsa.. U

blocks.text: The Bandais seek Mughal support by offering richer revenues and a share of offerings, hoping imperial greed will help tilt the dispute in their favor.
The Turks respond warmly to the plan, while Kahan Singh again advises waiting until the congregation disperses before any open confrontation.
Mughal support here is not abstract: it is courted through money, shrines, and factional opportunity.
